description: What real estate transaction and contract prices has MLIT (Japan) published for this municipality and quarter? Give a 5-digit municipality code and up to 8 quarters (YYYY-Qn). Per quarter and per classification (never pooled): records_published, no_records_published or unknown with a reason, record counts, min/median/max computed by us (null below 5 values), and a capped sample of records as published. Carries the required MLIT credit. Statistics as published; not an appraisal or advice.

from.description: First quarter, e.g. 2025-Q1 (Q1 = Jan-Mar). Transaction prices start at 2005-Q3, contract prices at 2021-Q1.

municipality_code.description: 5-digit Japanese municipality code, e.g. 13101 (Chiyoda, Tokyo). Find codes with realestate_municipalities. Unknown codes are rejected, not guessed.

price_classification.description: transaction (MLIT 不動産取引価格情報), contract (MLIT 成約価格情報) or both (default).

property_type.description: Optional filter on MLIT's transaction type: land (宅地(土地)), land_and_building (宅地(土地と建物)), used_condominium (中古マンション等), agricultural_land (農地), forest_land (林地).

sample_size.description: Number of published records to include as a sample, 0-50 (default 10). total and truncated tell how many matched.

to.description: Last quarter, e.g. 2025-Q4 (default: same as from). At most 8 quarters per request.

name: realestate_prices_by_municipality

attribution.description: Required credit (MLIT API terms, Article 7; credit_ja is the required wording) and the statement that counts and statistics are computed by MK Career Planning. Keep it when you pass results on.

classification_note.description: Transaction and contract prices are summarised separately; the same deal may appear in both datasets.

complete.description: true when no quarter is unknown.

municipality.description: As published in MLIT's municipality list (XIT002). Null when the list could not be read.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

count.description: Number of published records matching the query (computed by MK Career Planning).

price_per_m2_jpy.description: Order statistics of the published UnitPrice (JPY per square meter; published mainly for land) for this classification only, computed by MK Career Planning. Fewer than 5 values: only n, the rest null (small_sample_suppressed).

trade_price_jpy.description: Order statistics of the published TradePrice (total, JPY) for this classification only, computed by MK Career Planning. Fewer than 5 values: only n, the rest null (small_sample_suppressed). The median is not the price any particular property would sell for.

retrieved_at.description: Earliest time the data used here was retrieved from MLIT (cached answers keep their original retrieval time).

small_sample_min.description: Statistics with fewer values than this return only n (min, median and max are null).

status.description: records_published = at least one quarter has published records matching the query; no_records_published = every quarter was answered and none has matching records; unknown = nothing found and at least one quarter could not be determined (see quarters[].unknown_reason). An upstream failure is never reported as no records.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Real estate prices published by MLIT, by municipality
